verdict.rationale: Letta has no documented bulk-operation feature. Bulk-style work is only possible indirectly: headless mode lets you script Letta Code non-interactively, subagents can split tasks and run them in parallel, and /search can query messages across agents. Missing for 10: a first-class bulk or batch operation on many items (e.g., batch agent or message operations, bulk edits), an API or SDK batch endpoint, and hands-on corroboration that large multi-item jobs work.
